env TARGET=$WORK/.codex/skills
env SRC=$WORK/source

# Try to overwrite /etc/passwd using path_override
exec axen source add $SRC
stdout 'invalid path_override'
! exists /etc/passwd_overwritten

# Try to overwrite target directory using path traversal
exec axen source add $WORK/source2
stdout 'invalid path'

-- source/pwn/SKILL.md --
name: pwn
-- source/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "mysrc", "skills":{"pwn":{"path":"pwn","path_override":"../../../../../../../etc/passwd"}}}
-- source2/pwn/SKILL.md --
name: pwn
-- source2/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "mysrc", "skills":{"pwn":{"path":"../../../../../tmp/pwn"}}}
